contents.text: Added a Capture the Flag game mode
Added a new universal skin 'Subspace', granted upon winning 10 Capture the Flag games as each fighter
Added a double jump to all fighters, introducing a universal recovery. Various fighters have unique double jumps or additional jumps
Added a victory podium complete with music and fireworks, bringing some much needed post-game fanfare

- Reworked the health system to be a custom scale out of 400. The reasoning for this was mostly backend, but allows for some more fine-tuned balance changes that you will see reflected in the changelog

- Melee weapons can no longer swing off cooldown. Probably one of the most sweeping changes in this update, this creates some much needed spacing and punishing opportunities inbetween missed melee swings
- Doubled safe fall distance from 6 -> 12 blocks and fall damage multiplier from 1x -> 2x. This will mean fall damage happens much less frequently, but is much more dangerous at higher elevations
- Burning now deals 1 damage every tick
- Poison now deals 10 damage every second
- Doubled safe fall distance from 6 -> 12 blocks and fall damage multiplier from 1x -> 2x. This will mean fall damage happens much less frequently, but is much more dangerous at higher elevations
- Super Jump now requires you to stay in place to charge
- Increased speed of Ice Ball (6 m/s > 6.5 m/s)
- Super Jump now requires you to stay in place to charge
- Current Rage is now shown on the HUD
- Must now be opted into by pressing
- Can now be used multiple times per stock
- Fire Breath is now channeled by holding
- Added a fireball that can be fired with a short press
- Added 'Victory Road (Pokemon Ruby / Pokemon Sapphire)' track
- Added Minecraft World, which comes in five variants
